title: Pharming Group to participate in Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
summary: Pharming to participate in Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston on August 12-13, 2026....
body_markdown:
**Leiden, the** **Netherlands, August 4, 2026:** Pharming Group N.V. (Euronext Amsterdam: PHARM/Nasdaq: PHAR), today announced its participation in the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston on August 12-13, 2026.


Michael Levitan, VP Investor Relations and Capital Markets, will participate in a Fireside Chat Q&A session on Wednesday, August 12 at 10:00 EDT/16:00 CEST.


For more information about the conference, or to schedule a one-on-one meeting with Pharming’s management team, please contact Pharming’s Investor Relations team at[investor@pharming.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4KaEZ1z_h3pAG2ZCajdb7qwhXyq9jmViLPN6vrBeVW9kKTxrEAkYffkFKsAp3hpKqY1gUY_nIr-q9RENttTgPy6RT-FJ77WuhVuVjwGt2F4=) or your Canaccord Genuity representative.


**About Pharming Group N.V.**
Pharming Group N.V. (Euronext Amsterdam: PHARM/Nasdaq: PHAR) is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the lives of patients with rare, debilitating, and life-threatening diseases. We develop and commercialize innovative medicines, including small molecules and biologics. Pharming is headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands, with U.S. and European operations.


For more information, visit[www.pharming.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ilodoVs-f5Zs2DNeloSQ78ipO1anX0zgtCGtGjmPLwVz480AqIGQqPus8967vZ9wq-tdybyMNrRhnShJhzudL7XMR2bqABtSbUV3AzLLoos=) and find us on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_drEjiiYVB3IEaVH2Uij97gcN-snUE9npVKcBznvy7aefwcSzB3g-M7tbDx5BLvnBYY2U5k-3VvET3YACQ5g_K82u-agpP_vAaPxSrXgp5E=) .
